title: Deep learning-based mobile application for efficient eyelid tumor recognition in clinical images.
summary: A YOLO-based detector and classifier were evaluated on clinical eyelid images from 616 patients, with histopathology-supported tumor classes.
ai_technology: A YOLO-based detector and classifier analyzes clinical eyelid images to identify tumor classes.

evidence.tested: The model was evaluated on clinical images from 616 patients with histopathology-supported tumor classes.
evidence.unknown: The evidence is limited to the reported image cohort and reference labels; deployment benefit is not established.
evidence.ai_role: A YOLO-based detector and classifier analyzes clinical eyelid images to identify tumor classes.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
